'''1138''' was the designation of a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was known to continually malfunction at which point it began repeating, "Roger, roger," over and over again.
